gloss: to swing down; to bring down

definitions.gloss: to swing down; to bring down (a sword, hammer, axe)
definitions.explanation: To raise something held in the hand and bring it down forcefully in a swinging motion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{下|お}ろす。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ハンマー→ハンマー：25887_hanmaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{切|き}り→思い切る：04590_omoikiru⟧{振|ふ}り{下|お}ろした。
examples.english: He swung the hammer down with all his might.

examples.japanese: ⟦{斧|おの}→斧：12726_ono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧いっぱい{振|ふ}り{下|お}ろして、⟦{薪|まき}→薪：14118_maki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}った→割る：02334_waru⟧。
examples.english: I brought the axe down as hard as I could and split the firewood.

notes:
⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧ (to swing) + ⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧ (to lower).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{下|お}ろす
- Opposite motion: {振|ふ}り{上|あ}げる (to swing up, raise overhead)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{下|お}ろす: to bring down a sword
- ⟦ハンマー→ハンマー：25887_hanmaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{下|お}ろす: to swing a hammer down
- ⟦{拳|こぶし}→拳：05855_kobushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{下|お}ろす: to bring one's fist down
- ⟦{斧|おの}→斧：12726_ono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{下|お}ろす: to swing an axe down
